owner_request_2026_11_16_improvements.statement_summary: propose many improvements with a native question tool; the owner chose: animated full-screen player, Apple-style lyrics, automatic colour theme, remove Home widgets except Votre semaine (then: the four shortcut tiles and the For you card) and create Android widgets (large glass player, your week, mix, mini controls), Ketvoice Wrapped, lyrics share image, visual equalizer, Ketmix on skip, volume normalisation, in-app update, faster startup.

done.player_background: ArtworkFlowBackground: three blurred 48 px copies of the cover rotating in opposite directions (64, 86, 112 s), drawn every other frame while playing, frozen when paused or with reduced motion / high performance / Quest; replaces the AGSL mesh under the 'Fond animé' setting
done.lyrics: word lift 2.5 dp and glow on words held 900 ms or more (canvas drawing of whole words when the word timing covers every letter, else the former flat drawing); sung line scale up to 1.5 % from the SonicMeter bass; progressive blur already existed
done.cover_accent: setting coverAccent (off by default): the app accent follows the playing cover's readable accent, animated 700 ms
done.home: For you card and shortcut tiles removed from HomeScreen (composables kept for the widgets and tests)
done.widgets: GlassPlayerWidget 4x2, WeekWidget 2x2, MixWidget 2x2 (opens the app with the mix id; MainActivity plays PersonalMixes.tracks or opens the mix page), MiniControlsWidget 2x1; one updater, works only while one is placed; progress refreshed every 30 s while playing; picker labels in 11 languages
done.wrapped: yearly DayStat in listening-history 'years' from 5.9.0; recap of the year with 25+ plays, else all-time counts labelled as such; five-page story over the flowing cover; 1080x1920 PNG shared via FileProvider with the site address
done.lyrics_share: already existed (Moment card, story size); now drawn over the blurred cover with white text
done.equalizer: ten bands 31 Hz-16 kHz; DynamicsProcessing pre-EQ with exact band gains and a limiter, falling back to Equalizer with interpolation; draggable curve and seven presets; five-band settings converted by interpolation
done.skip: with Ketmix on, a manual next fades the title out in 320 ms (equal-power) and the next one in over 850 ms once it plays; not a two-deck mix
done.normalisation: LevelingAudioProcessor between DeckMixProcessor and ReverbAudioProcessor, setting volumeLeveling off by default: gated power average (6 s), gain toward -18 dBFS RMS within -9..+6 dB moving with a 4 s constant, soft clip above 0.9; state kept across titles
done.update: already existed: GitHub release check, download, archive and signature verification, installer
done.startup: LyricsSearch.init and LauncherIcons.apply moved to a background thread; Discord.start posted after the first frame; Home already showed its cached feed first

known_limitations: Wrapped's yearly figures start with 5.9.0: before enough plays this year, the recap covers all the listening counted since the first launch.
Ketmix on skip is a short fade, not a beat-matched two-deck mix.
The leveler adapts over several seconds: the first seconds of a much louder or quieter title still differ.
Widgets refresh the progress bar every 30 seconds while a title plays.
Ket 27 stays an alpha: several pages keep Ketvoice's own structure.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
